text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Waiver of final tranche of debts affirms world's confidence in Egyptian economy and in Mubarak's policies. Prime minister tells public gathering in Hurghada that waiver of $4.2 billion and its interest is proof from IMF of the soundness of Egypt's economic performance.
- First lady says there must be a strategy to deal with problems of those with disabilities.
- Field Marshal Tantawi says that the armed forces' main goal is to protect Egypt's borders.
- Mubarak and Italian prime minister will examine on Sunday Egyptian-European cooperation.
- Moussa says Chirac's Mideast trip shows Europe's interests in peace process.
- Ganzouri says Egypt is going through period of great development in all areas with the leadership of Mubarak.
- CNN broadcasts story on Mubarak's interest in Toshka overflow canal.
- Mostafa Bakry referred to trial in State Security court and to Criminal court on charges of invading privacy of Jihan Sadat and libelling Mahgoub.
- Moussa says Africa still supports Boutros-Ghali.
- Egypt welcomes Chirac's visit and rejects interference in Iraq.
